readerQuestion: What protections can a US school request for education AI, and which tools remain outside this agreement?

sources.readScope: Definitions, opt-in applicability, training/safety exception, companion prohibition, audit/certification exceptions and signatures inspected; not a claim that all 31 pages were independently analyzed

sourceBoundFacts: MOA signatures dated September7; joint public announcement September9.

US EDU Customers may opt in for primarily education-designed generative AI products. Definition explicitly excludes general productivity, collaboration, communications, search, cloud, development and workplace assistance products.
Covered data training prohibited except tightly limited safety/security processing. Telemetry definition and safety exception must be retained.
Companion features designed for attachment/dependency or engagement beyond learning task are prohibited.
AP reports November1 availability, criticism that safety protections do not settle whether classroom AI is appropriate, and other companies have not all signed.
doNotClaim: Microsoft has completed all certifications: ISO42001 target December2027; FedRAMP not available for Microsoft Education Products
Existing voluntary MAI consultation implements these school protections
deduplication: Distinct event from published microsoft-humanist-code-20260915: signed school procurement privacy commitments versus voluntary future-MAI public consultation.
